entity: The 5th Circuit's cases at the Supreme Court: share brought by the federal government, 2021-24 vs 2015-20
why: Sources name the 5th Circuit but count all its Supreme Court cases one term at a time (11 in 2023-24, 13 in 2024-25, 11 in 2025-26) or show single agency appeals (SEC). None measures the federal-government share or the 2015-20 vs 2021-24 shift, so 16 of 38 vs 1 of 26 can't be lined up with anything.
